in: I found the cause of the lost rows. The sync queue dropped a batch whenever the phone went offline in the middle of a retry, because the retry loop reset its cursor before the batch was written. I changed the loop to keep the cursor until the write is confirmed, and added a test that goes offline halfway through. All 42 tests pass.
note: Past 200 characters, the text ends after the last sentence that fits.
